scope: Exploratory read-only query latency on the current repository, not Story delivery performance
primaryTime: uninstrumented handler elapsedMs, excludes import/build/process startup
instrumentedWitnesses: one per arm and query to count detail calls and digest input/output
sameCoveragePerformanceCase: review: outputs must be byte-equivalent before timing comparison
correctnessCase: active: baseline omissions prevent equal-output speedup claim; report observations without attributing percentage
analysis: all runs retained; report medians and range; no statistical or global speedup claim from three pairs
inputRule: union of instrumented input paths is checked before and after timing; changed input makes the contrast invalid
noWrites: handlers only read live Story state; no CLI lifecycle mutation, worktree migration or gate relaxation

amendment.reason: Another owner changed B-de09 config during the initial read-only campaign. Retain that invalid attempt; repeat only the equal-output REVIEW case with the same pair count/order and fresh input witnesses. No outcome-based sample removal.
